execution.description: Built the Challenge-neutral design search (registered methods, neutral request, freeze manifest, equal-query pilot), battery's adapter over search_commitment and priced choices, and Graphite's method-proposal task; ran a fake pilot on a synthetic analytic cell over EV2 development conditions, and on a synthetic second Challenge.

expected: A proposed method runs at equal budgets against the fixed grid, commits before any reference access, refuses EV4 conditions and drifted code, and selects by the baseline's rule.
observed: 73 passed. Screen-then-confirm returned the fixed grid's design on the synthetic cell with fewer model queries from every screening condition, and coarse-to-fine never beat the grid's optimum. The first pricing draft imported EV4's protected conditions into the shared package, which would have made it battery-only; it moved to battery's side. EV4's 8 x 4 model grid is entirely protected, so no development Mode X grid can reuse it.
keep: A proposal names a registered method and bounded parameters; Carbon runs only its own code.
Freeze code, dependencies and every configuration before the pilot, and refuse to run on drift.
change: Measure reference solve time on the reference hardware before pricing any paid optimizer run.
Run a check on each new shared module for Challenge-specific imports before it is committed.
